texts.ContactPoints_Page_Intro: Copies each person's email addresses, phone numbers and current addresses to Salesforce Contact Points after every save, for the apps in your org that read them. BarnCRM is the source: edits made to a copy elsewhere are put back. Run the backfill once after installing to copy everyone already here.
